name: S.S. Anne Luxury Liner
summary: Board the opulent luxury liner docked in Vermilion harbor using your S.S. Ticket. Clear the staterooms of wealthy Gentlemen and salty Sailors, secure Krabby Legs in the galley, battle Rival Blue on 2F, and soothe the seasick Captain.

items.name: HM01 Cut
items.method: Given by the Captain in his private cabin after soothing his seasickness

items.name: Krabby Legs
items.method: Given by the Chef in the ship kitchen after accepting Hotel Quest 3: Seafood Cocktail

items.name: Rare Candy
items.method: On the floor in cabin Room B4

items.name: Max Ether
items.method: On the floor in cabin Room B1

items.name: TM31 Brick Break
items.method: On the floor in cabin Room 13 on the Upper Deck

Gift Pokémon.name: Torkoal
Gift Pokémon.rates: Given by Sailor in cabin after earning Thunder Badge

navigation_notes: CRITICAL GROUND TRUTH NOTE: Unlike vanilla Pokémon games, the S.S. Anne does NOT depart when you leave the ship or receive HM01 Cut. It remains permanently moored in Vermilion harbor! Your personal stateroom bed provides free, infinite party healing, saving trips to the Pokémon Center. Be sure to speak to the chef in the kitchen to pick up the Krabby Legs for Hotel Quest 3 (Seafood Cocktail).
